gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase close to the size of its capitals, with an e that opens like a pried clasp. Chelsea Market is the loud one, and its bold, expressive display shapes make that steadier serif look all the more dignified.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-slabo-13px: Dignified is the first word for Slabo 13px, a classic serif with tall a, e and s shapes and big open counters. Slabo 13px stays easy on the eye over many lines, while Chelsea Market up top keeps things bold and expressive.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-suwannaphum: Chelsea Market's g hangs an open lower curve below the line. Suwannaphum answers with an editorial serif whose c gapes like a bent paperclip, and its tall x-height would crowd the heading if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-author: Author reads as a classic serif with a slight swell on its bowls, refined and dignified. And Cherry Cream Soda, sparse and widely spaced, is the bolder voice, better kept to brief copy.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-gf-bhutuka-expa: BhuTuka Expanded One slows the eye to a leisurely walk, its curvy classic serif letters feeling unclamped and literary. But Cherry Cream Soda is for making an entrance with wide, sparse letters, while the body font does its best work holding a steady line.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-gf-hepta-slab: Stretched out, wide and wire-straight, Hepta Slab has open counters that breathe into the white space around every word. Cherry Cream Soda earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-gf-kiwi-maru: Loose, traditional and a bit editorial, Kiwi Maru lets its terminals stop far from the stem. And Cherry Cream Soda, sparse and wide, gives that serif a showy lead to follow on the page.
gen-gf-cherry-cream-soda-gf-stint-ultra-: Stint Ultra Expanded reads as a classic serif where each character floats apart, with a pipe-cleaner feel to every form. Stint Ultra Expanded looks best with room around it, so giving Cherry Cream Soda a generous size above keeps the spacing in step.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-crimson-pro: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals. Crimson Pro follows as a refined text serif, close-packed, with a subtle thick and thin cadence under that stencil-brush line.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-neco: Horseshoe curves, heavy diagonals, zero fuss. And Neco, a dignified text serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, wants a heading larger than itself so Cherry Swash can keep its commanding edge.
